description: This file provides the definition of the MetalDeviceInfo struct and a function to create it from an MTLDevice object, including platform-specific version handling.

classes.name: MetalDeviceInfo
classes.description: A struct holding the device's name and the Metal language version used.

methods.name: createDeviceInfo
methods.description: Creates a MetalDeviceInfo object from an MTLDevice, populating name and languageVersion based on platform availability.
